uniform_random_sessions.note: Measured with final V12 strong-gate logic.

synthetic_dealer_sessions.note: Synthetic slow-drift transition pattern with noise and occasional large jumps; functional sensitivity test only.

synthetic_auto_roulette_sessions.note: Synthetic stable mechanical transition pattern with lower noise; functional sensitivity test only.

disclaimer: Synthetic structured generators are deliberately predictable and are not evidence that a real roulette wheel or dealer will produce the same behavior. The random-session test is the relevant false-positive stress test.
